name: download
description:
Download a file into the local workspace. Two modes — pass EXACTLY ONE of `index` or `url`:
- `index`: click an element that triggers a download. Use this when you can't get a direct URL — e.g. a button/link whose download is JS-driven, a `blob:` URL, a form-POST download, or a `Content-Disposition: attachment` response. The host captures whatever download the click produces.
- `url`: download a direct URL using the current page's session (cookies/auth apply), for when you already have a stable file URL.
The file is saved under the workspace `downloads/` folder and the returned `path` can be read with the file tools (Read/Glob). For very large files the call returns as soon as the transfer is underway with `status: "downloading"` plus byte progress — the file finishes streaming in the background, so re-check the path a bit later rather than re-issuing the download.

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: Element index (from the latest observation's elements[]) to click in order to trigger a download. Use for downloads whose URL you can't obtain directly. Provide exactly one of index or url.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: Absolute URL of a file to download directly (uses the current page's cookies/session). Provide exactly one of index or url.

inputs.name: filename
inputs.description: Optional filename to save as (basename only, no directories). Defaults to the server-suggested name or the URL's last path segment.
